question: Who among the following was the author of Virasoliyam?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Buddhamitra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Buddhamitra** was a renowned Tamil scholar and poet of ancient India.
 
• He is credited with authoring the grammatical text **Virasoliyam**, which is a significant work on Tamil grammar.
 
• Virasoliyam is a treatise that integrates the grammatical traditions of Tamil and Sanskrit, focusing on poetics and prosody.
 
• The work was composed during the reign of the Chola king **Raja Raja Chola I**, reflecting the rich literary and cultural heritage of the period.
 
• Virasoliyam played an important role in consolidating Tamil grammar and is considered a key text in Tamil literature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ottakuthar**
 
 
• Ottakuthar was a medieval Tamil poet and a contemporary of the Chola kings Kulothunga Chola II and Rajaraja Chola II.
 
• He is known for his significant contributions to Tamil literature, including works like **Ulas** (narrative poetry).
 
• His notable works include *Kulothunga Cholan Ula*, *Rajasooyam*, and *Saraswati Andhadhi*.
 
 
 
• **Amirthasagarar**
 
 
• Amirthasagarar was a Tamil Jain scholar and writer.
 
• He is known for his Jain literary contributions, but there is no evidence linking him to *Virasoliyam*.
 
• His works often revolved around Jain philosophies and ethics.
 
 
 
• **Sekkilar**
 
 
• Sekkilar was a prominent Tamil scholar and poet who lived during the reign of Kulothunga Chola II.
 
• He is best known for composing the **Periyapuranam**, which narrates the life stories of the 63 Nayanars (devotees of Lord Shiva).
 
• This work is considered one of the greatest Tamil epics and holds immense significance in Tamil Shaivism.
